Name: Better Start
Author: nebulouscharlotte
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/X6IetmN.png[/img]


When starting a new farm with this mod installed, it will automatically add a few items to your inventory when you start and add some gold. Below is the list of things which it adds by default.

➔ Coal x20

➔ Wood x100

➔ Stone x100

➔ Fiber x50

➔ Clay x10

➔ Mixed Seeds x25

➔ 1500 Gold


[img]https://i.imgur.com/4DPMilP.png[/img]

➔ Download and install all required mods:
Content Patcher
SMAPI

➔ Download the main file for Better Start

➔ Play!

[color=#00FF7F][b][b][b][b][size=4]➔ [/size][/b][/b][/b][/b]Enjoy![/color]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G2HCBdc.png[/img]

➔ Portuguese

➔ English

➔ Mandarin (Thanks to [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/vocal688?gameId=1303]vocal688[/url] for the translation)

New languages ​​will be available soon
